items: Re-reviews continue the earlier session and use a delta review when that session cannot resume.
Settled native reviewers stop their processes and MCP servers while preserving resumable conversations.
Follow-up artifacts stay writable and completion retains generated publication selections in its manifest.
Publication gates check secret values before approval and can publish explicitly accepted review findings.
Settled runs are removed after 48 hours unless decisions, slots, open PRs or storage dependencies keep them.
